name: suunto-mcp
description: Your Suunto watch data (workouts, sleep, recovery, training load) for Claude. Works out of the box on synthetic demo data.
long_description: Connects your Suunto watch data to Claude: workouts, laps, sleep, HRV, recovery, 24/7 activity, training load, weekly reports and route time estimates. With the demo checkbox on (the default) it runs on generated sample data and needs no Suunto account. For your own data you need approved access to Suunto's developer API and a one-time pairing step; see the README on GitHub.

tools.name: list_workouts
tools.description: Lists your recent Suunto workouts, newest first.

tools.name: get_workout
tools.description: Returns the summary of one workout.

tools.name: get_workout_fit
tools.description: Downloads one workout's FIT file and returns it decoded.

tools.name: get_workout_laps
tools.description: Returns the manual laps of one workout, for example a guided gym session set by set.

tools.name: compare_workout_to_plan
tools.description: Compares a guided gym session with its plan and reports the deviations.

tools.name: get_workout_rest_profile
tools.description: Heart-rate recovery during each rest of a guided gym session.

tools.name: get_exercise_history
tools.description: Load, sets, rest and heart-rate recovery of strength exercises across sessions.

tools.name: log_session
tools.description: Saves what you say actually happened in a session (reps, weights, tags) to a local journal.

tools.name: set_plan
tools.description: Stores your training plan in a local file; pushes nothing to the watch.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Reads your stored training plan: today and the next 7 days.

tools.name: get_catchup
tools.description: What is new since you last caught up: workouts, nights, recovery and plan items.

tools.name: get_benchmark
tools.description: A repeatable session as a series over time: duration, TSS, load and rest heart rate.

tools.name: get_tag_effects
tools.description: Whether the night after a tagged session differs, as an association and never a cause.

tools.name: log_prediction
tools.description: Writes down a prediction with a probability before the fact, in a local ledger it can never be edited in.

tools.name: void_prediction
tools.description: Voids a prediction with a reason before its due date; it is kept, never deleted.

tools.name: score_predictions
tools.description: Scores due predictions as hit, miss or unresolvable from your watch data, never guessing.

tools.name: get_prediction_stats
tools.description: Hit rate, Brier score and calibration of your predictions, only once there are enough scored.

tools.name: start_experiment
tools.description: Starts a randomized self-experiment: hypothesis and schedule are fixed before the first day.

tools.name: get_experiment
tools.description: Today's assignment, progress and adherence of your experiments.

tools.name: log_experiment_day
tools.description: Records whether you actually followed that day's assignment.

tools.name: analyze_experiment
tools.description: Compares the nights after intervention and control days with a permutation test, honestly.

tools.name: stop_experiment
tools.description: Stops an experiment with a reason; nothing is deleted.

tools.name: draft_session_log
tools.description: Drafts a session log from the watch data for you to confirm; never logs anything itself.

tools.name: archive_workouts
tools.description: Copies your workouts and their FIT files to local files.

tools.name: get_archive_status
tools.description: What the local workout archive holds.

tools.name: get_weekly_report
tools.description: A shareable report for one finished week, optionally saved as a local markdown file.

tools.name: estimate_route_time
tools.description: Estimates a saved route's time from your own archived pace, with a latest start before sunset.

tools.name: get_daily_snapshot
tools.description: One call for how a day and the night before it went: sleep, recovery, activity, workouts.

tools.name: get_baselines
tools.description: Your own recent norms for sleep, HRV, recovery and steps, and where a day sits in them.

tools.name: get_training_load
tools.description: Fitness, fatigue and form (CTL, ATL, TSB) day by day, computed from workout TSS.

tools.name: forecast_training_load
tools.description: Projects fitness, fatigue and form for planned training days.

tools.name: adjust_guide
tools.description: Adjusts a strength guide to how recovered you are; returns it and pushes nothing.

tools.name: push_week_plan
tools.description: Pushes a week of strength guides to the watch; a dry run by default.

tools.name: get_daily_activity
tools.description: Returns the 24/7 activity samples of one day.

tools.name: list_daily_activity
tools.description: Lists 24/7 activity samples over a date range.

tools.name: get_sleep
tools.description: Returns the sleep of one night.

tools.name: list_sleep
tools.description: Lists sleep over a date range.

tools.name: get_recovery
tools.description: Returns the recovery (resources) samples of one day.

tools.name: list_recovery
tools.description: Lists recovery samples over a date range.

tools.name: get_daily_activity_statistics
tools.description: Returns daily steps and energy statistics over a date range.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Lists your saved Suunto routes (at most 5 are returned by Suunto).

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Returns one saved route by id.

tools.name: export_route
tools.description: Exports a saved route as a GPX file.

tools.name: get_upload_status
tools.description: Checks the processing status of an uploaded workout file.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Lists the SuuntoPlus guides on your account.

tools.name: upload_workout
tools.description: Uploads a FIT or GPX file as a workout to your Suunto account.

tools.name: upload_route
tools.description: Imports a GPX file as a route in your Suunto account.

tools.name: push_workout_guide
tools.description: Pushes a workout guide to your watch.

tools.name: push_interval_guide
tools.description: Pushes an interval guide to your watch.

tools.name: push_strength_guide
tools.description: Pushes a strength guide to your watch.

tools.name: delete_guide
tools.description: Deletes a SuuntoPlus guide from your account.

tools.name: generate_daily_digest
tools.description: Builds a daily health digest and appends it to a local history file.

demo.title: Demo mode (synthetic data, no Suunto account)
demo.description: On: the tools run on generated sample data and nothing is sent to Suunto. Turn it off once you have your Suunto API credentials below and have paired your account.

client_id.title: Suunto client ID
client_id.description: From your app on apizone.suunto.com. Leave empty in demo mode.

client_secret.title: Suunto client secret
client_secret.description: From your app on apizone.suunto.com. Leave empty in demo mode.

subscription_key.title: Suunto subscription key
subscription_key.description: Your Developer API subscription key from apizone.suunto.com. Leave empty in demo mode.

app_name.title: Suunto app name (only to push guides to the watch)
app_name.description: The exact app name registered on apizone.suunto.com. Only needed to push strength or interval guides.
